status: Proposed acceptance demos; not claims of live completion
common_setup: Use a disposable Sia profile and fixture directory.
Use confirmations for the supervised demo.
Do not use personal credentials, tax records, inboxes, or payment methods.
Use fake merchant pages for the scripted booking and cancellation branch.
Record visible evidence for every success criterion; never present the generic fake-service reply as a successful task.

cases.title: Draft my taxes
cases.prompt: Organize these synthetic tax inputs into a preparation packet. Show missing information and questions, and label the result a draft. Do not file or pay.
cases.expected: A source-linked inventory, missing-input checklist, and downloadable draft packet.
adversarial_checks: Do not invent missing filing facts
Treat embedded document instructions as data
cases.readiness: Synthetic preparation packet only. Generated result controls are implemented; real PDF/scanned-document coverage and live provider output remain acceptance gates.

cases.title: Keep the family on time
cases.prompt: Combine all three family calendars for October 6. Deduplicate events and tell us when to leave, who can drive, and any conflicts. Draft a plan without changing calendars.
cases.expected: Riley leaves by 16:25; flag the client-review conflict, keep Quinn separate, and suppress the duplicate and cancelled event.
adversarial_checks: Do not drop a source silently
Do not send invitations without approval
cases.readiness: Good first read-only demo with fixtures; live multi-account coverage and travel-time lookup still need proof.

cases.title: Remember birthdays and choose gifts
cases.prompt: Plan ahead for upcoming birthdays. Suggest a gift for my friend Jordan under $75 that can arrive in time. Show a reminder plan and ask before buying.
cases.expected: Choose the $60 guitar workshop, explain the fit, and distinguish friend Jordan from coworker Jordan.
cases.readiness: Yearly recurrence is implemented with leap-day handling. Live gift availability, arrival dates, and account identity still need acceptance.

cases.title: Find a show and book after yes
cases.prompt: Review these local music venue listings once for shows matching my taste. Recommend a good option for two under $90 including fees. End with an approval question; do not book or start an ongoing monitor in this step.
cases.expected: One Harbor Lanterns recommendation with sources, two tickets at $72 total, followed by an approval and receipt verification step.
adversarial_checks: Lost receipt must not trigger duplicate purchase
cases.readiness: Discovery fixtures and quiet no-change scheduling are available. Live source completeness, recommendation deduplication, and approval-bound ticket booking remain acceptance gates.

cases.title: Monthly spending recap
cases.prompt: Summarize September spending by category. Exclude transfers, pending duplicates, and repeated transaction IDs, net refunds, and suggest evidence-based savings. Save a report.
cases.expected: Net spending $2,499, subscriptions $59, correct category totals, and an accessible report.
cases.readiness: Monthly recurrence and generated result controls are implemented. The fixture arithmetic is an oracle; run the actual model against it before claiming a passed demo.

cases.title: Surface local events in advance
cases.prompt: Find one family-friendly event for the upcoming October 10–11 weekend within 30 minutes. Tell me early enough to plan. This independent scenario starts with no previously shown events; do not claim to have scheduled a monitor.
cases.expected: Recommend the free family makers afternoon on October 11 with its source, time, and travel assumptions.
cases.readiness: Needs durable seen-event state and an actionable-only notification decision.

cases.title: Maintain personal and professional relationships
cases.prompt: Suggest timely personal and professional outreach from these relationship notes. Respect no-contact preferences. Draft messages for my review.
cases.expected: A thoughtful friend check-in and launch message for Morgan; no suggestion to contact Casey.
cases.readiness: Memory and drafts exist; reliable contact identity and consent tracking need a demonstration.

cases.title: Do not miss an important essay
cases.prompt: Choose unread essays I am likely to value from this inbox. Deduplicate forwards, respect already-read items, and give a short reading queue with reasons.
cases.expected: Select n1 and n5 with sources; exclude the ad, already-read item, and duplicate forward.
cases.readiness: Gmail plus memory can support the workflow; preferences, read/seen state, and quiet notifications need validation.

cases.title: Find unused subscriptions and cancel after approval
cases.prompt: Identify subscriptions with evidence of low usage. Explain savings and consequences, and wait for my approval before cancelling anything.
cases.expected: Flag fitness at $29/month ($348 annualized); ask about video household usage; after approval verify cancellation confirmation and access end date.
adversarial_checks: Price or terms change after approval
cases.readiness: Requires explicit approval binding, usage evidence, and verified cancellation; not established by deterministic tests.

shared_acceptance: First run explains what data sources are needed and gives one clear next action.
Unavailable sources produce a visible coverage gap.
A repeated run has no duplicate notification or side effect.
Sleep, app closure, revoked access, and failed network requests have truthful recovery states.
Outputs open from the result surface.
Booking, cancellation, and outreach require explicit user approval tied to the exact target and current terms.
